verdict.rationale: The ADR documents a single CLI route, `claude plugins install mattpocock-skills`, that an agent could plausibly run itself, and `npx skills update` is a scriptable update command. However, the aihero installer has users "pick the skills and agents you use", which suggests interactive selection. Nothing confirms that either path runs fully promptless or headless. missing for 10: explicit non-interactive/headless install flags or docs, evidence that the npx installer can run without selection prompts, per-skill unattended install, hands-on corroboration of an agent completing an install end to end.
